pages.text: This diary is the progression guide for the mod. It follows seven stages.$(br2)$(bold)Stages:$(reset) 1. Mine ore → 2. Refine essence → 3. Build the energy grid → 4. Mass-produce with machines → 5. Automate with the Miner → 6. Advanced industry (ingots, equipment, catalysts, logistics) → 7. Reactor and Fusion.$(br2)$(bold)How to read it:$(reset) each page states what to do first and why, then links to the entry that contains the details. Blue text is clickable. Warnings must not be skipped; they describe the failure modes.

$(bold)Stage 1 · Mining:$(reset) search underground for $(l:akaishi:ore)Akaishi Ore Clusters$(/l). The Overworld, Nether and End all contain them, and one block mined with a pickaxe drops several crystals.$(br2)$(bold)Stage 2 · Processing:$(reset) craft 9 crystals into a Raw Akaishi Block, feed it to the Purifier to extract essence, then concentrate it further. The complete crystal → block → essence → concentrate chain and its fuel values are in $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).$(br2)The later currency is the $(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l); review that entry to identify it.$(br2)Raw Akaishi Blocks should be stockpiled early: generators and the purifier both consume them.

$(bold)Stage 3 · The Akaishi Energy grid:$(reset) a machine without power does nothing, so automation requires a power source first. Read $(l:akaishi:energy_basics)Akaishi Energy Basics$(/l), build the $(l:akaishi:generator)Energy Generator$(/l) to convert fuel into power, store it in Energy Cells, then route it to every machine.$(br2)$(bold)Stage 4 · Machine production:$(reset) use the $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) to grind ores into dust, press dust back into blocks with the Compressor, and complete the material set with the Transformer and Plant Cultivator.$(br2)The basic machines come first because pulverizing and pressing are prerequisites for many recipes. The power grid must be operational before automation begins.

$(bold)Stage 5 · Miner automation:$(reset) once materials permit, build the $(l:akaishi:miner_structure)Miner Structure$(/l), a multiblock that mines vanilla ores automatically.$(br2)$(bold)Stage 6 · Advanced industry:$(reset) condense Netherite Ingots into Akaishi Ingots with the Energy Aggregator, generate crystals automatically with the $(l:akaishi:catalyst)Catalyst$(/l) while a Collector harvests them, transport items through Item Pipes, then produce $(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l) at the Equipment Forger.$(br2)This stage consumes large quantities of materials. The grid must be expanded before it starts.

$(bold)Stage 7 · Advanced power:$(reset) when the grid can no longer supply the large machines, replace the power source. Study $(l:akaishi:fuel_system)Fuel & Cooling$(/l) first, then build the $(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l); one unit outperforms dozens of generators but requires heat management.$(br2)Beyond the reactor are the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l), the liquid-fuel and plasma chains, and wireless energy for cross-dimension transmission.$(br2)Reactors explode: overheating starts a 10-second countdown, so an escape route must always be available. Fusion is the final power tier and requires preparation.

$(bold)Progress check:$(reset) progression can continue once the ore source, the power source, dust production and the Miner structure are understood. Before the late game, complete the reactor heat-control material.$(br2)Beyond Akaishi Energy is Life Energy; craft the Book of Life for that manual.
